text:
maria: FYI customer reports duplicate billing when SDK retries after auth refresh. They see two successful POSTs for the same request id. Happening intermittently.

devon: ugh. likely AbortController reuse + token refresh race with undici. any repro or sdk version?

maria: repro attached. Node 20, @redwood/sdk-node 0.12.3, undici 6.12.0. Logs show 401 then retry, then 200 twice. request id header same.

sven: can you paste the minimal repro snippet? also did they use global fetch or sdk http client?

maria: they call sdk.createEmbedding which ultimately uses fetch under the hood. snippet:

```
const ac = new AbortController();
await api.call(params, { signal: ac.signal });
// token refresh triggers while backoff waiting to retry
// retry reuses same signal causing both original and retry to succeed in pathological timing
```

sam: interesting — undici's pooling + AbortSignal handoff can cause the original inflight to not be cancelled cleanly if signal reused across retries. we've seen dup POSTs when body is non-rewindable.

devon: need concrete repro demonstrating retry triggered after 401 + token refresh path. can we try cloning the body or using fresh AbortController per attempt as a workaround?

maria: tried fresh AbortController per attempt locally -> no dupes. Customer can't patch quickly. any server-side mitigation? idempotency key? they don't set one currently.

sven: recommend: 1) advise customer to set idempotency-key header, 2) short-term SDK patch to avoid reusing AbortSignal across retry attempts and to clone/rewind body when possible, 3) escalate to eng-runtime for undici signal handoff investigation.

support-bot: escalation created: #ticket-50123. Priority: high. Linked to billing team.

oncall-eng: assigned to me. devon can you gather minimal failing trace and exact sequence (401 -> refresh -> retry) and a small containerized repro? include network logs and node profile.

devon: on it. I'll spin up a repro harness and try with undici 7.x and latest sdk canary. If upgrade fixes, we'll publish guidance and an emergency patch release.

maria: thanks. I'll message customer the idempotency suggestion and ETA for patch. keeping this thread updated.

sam: note for postmortem: measure how many dup charges occurred and whether rollback/credits needed. billing lead pinged.

maria: closing loop for now, will post results here when devon has repro or patch. :thumbsup:
